svg.text: Protect the app before changing PHP
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 · protected backups and elevated Windows PowerShell
Create the tested database/files backup from Backup and Restore the Help Desk. Copy the current
PHP folder, php.ini and any additional INI files to protected storage outside the web root.
Record extensions, VC++ runtime, pool identity, runtime-folder ACLs and the existing
Run the IIS configuration backup below. Record its generated name. This backup covers server
configuration; restoring it blindly can change other websites. Our first rollback choice will
be restoring only this site’s recorded PHP mapping.
Set the help desk Offline, stop PracticeHelpdesk and keep new tickets paused. If you use a
temporary VMware checkpoint on this disposable member server, record it as an additional
recovery aid, not a substitute for the tested database/files backup. Never use this as a
